system_configurations.name: RCCL-Tests-Revoke
system_configurations.description: ncclCommRevoke test config. Runs all RevokeMPITest and RevokeNonBlockingMPITest tests across 2-rank, 4-rank single-node, and 4-rank multi-node configurations.

mpi_args.mellanox: --mca oob_tcp_if_include eth1 --mca btl_tcp_if_include eth1 --mca btl ^vader,openib --bind-to none
mpi_args.ainic: --mca oob_tcp_if_include eno0 --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno0 --mca btl ^vader,openib --bind-to none
mpi_args.thor2: --oversubscribe --mca plm_rsh_agent srun --mca oob_tcp_if_include eno8303 --mca btl_tcp_if_include eno8303 --mca btl ^openib --bind-to none

tests.name: Revoke_NullComm_Rejected
tests.description: ncclCommRevoke with null handle must return ncclInvalidArgument

tests.name: Revoke_BadFlags_Rejected
tests.description: ncclCommRevoke with unsupported revokeFlags must return ncclInvalidArgument

tests.name: Revoke_RejectsCollectives
tests.description: After revoke, collective operations must return ncclInvalidUsage on all ranks

tests.name: Revoke_DoubleRevoke_Rejected
tests.description: Revoking the same communicator twice must be rejected with ncclInvalidArgument

tests.name: Revoke_ThenFinalize_Rejected
tests.description: ncclCommFinalize on a revoked communicator must be rejected with ncclInvalidUsage

tests.name: Revoke_ThenDestroy_CleanLifecycle
tests.description: Revoke leaves the communicator safe for explicit ncclCommDestroy on every rank

tests.name: Revoke_ThenSplit_ChildWorks
tests.description: After revoke, ncclCommSplit on the parent yields a child that runs AllReduce successfully

tests.name: InFlightCollective_Revoke_Destroy_Clean
tests.description: In-flight collective then revoke then ncclCommDestroy must return ncclSuccess on every rank (revoke != abort)

tests.name: Revoke_NonBlocking_ReturnsInProgress
tests.description: Non-blocking revoke must return ncclSuccess or ncclInProgress and drain to ncclSuccess via ncclCommGetAsyncError; later collectives must be rejected

tests.name: Revoke_NonBlocking_AbortedMidFlight
tests.description: ncclCommAbort issued mid-flight on a non-blocking revoke must wind down the async-job worker via its abortFlag and return without hanging

tests.name: RevokeThenShrink_ChildWorks
tests.description: After revoke, ncclCommShrink on the parent excludes the last rank and the 3-rank child runs AllReduce successfully

tests.name: Collective_Revoke_Shrink_Collective
tests.description: In-flight AllReduce followed by revoke, shrink to a 3-rank child, and a second AllReduce on the child (real ring topology)

tests.name: P2P_Revoke_Shrink_P2P
tests.description: In-flight P2P send/recv pairs, revoke parent, shrink to a 3-rank child, and exchange P2P on the child (at least one rank pair active)

tests.name: IncompleteCollective_Revoke_Shrink_Collective
tests.description: Rank np-1 skips AllReduce so the collective is truly in-flight when revoke fires; verifies device-side abortFlag path and recovery via shrink

tests.name: ShrinkAbort_InFlight_ChildWorks_RankRenumbering
tests.description: ncclCommShrink with NCCL_SHRINK_ABORT terminates in-flight collective and the child reports correct renumbered rank/size and runs AllReduce

tests.name: Revoke_NonBlocking_ThenShrink_NoRace
tests.description: Race commRevokeAsync worker thread against an immediate ncclCommShrink on the same parent across 10 iterations; shrink must succeed

tests.name: InFlightCollective_Revoke_Destroy_Clean
tests.description: In-flight collective then revoke then ncclCommDestroy must return ncclSuccess on every rank (revoke != abort); over IB transport verifies QP cleanup with network buffers in flight

tests.name: Collective_Revoke_Shrink_Collective
tests.description: In-flight AllReduce followed by revoke, shrink to a 3-rank child, and a second AllReduce on the child; over IB transport verifies network buffer teardown and rebuild

tests.name: P2P_Revoke_Shrink_P2P
tests.description: In-flight P2P send/recv pairs, revoke parent, shrink to a 3-rank child, and exchange P2P on the child; over IB transport tests different teardown path than SHM/P2P

tests.name: IncompleteCollective_Revoke_Shrink_Collective
tests.description: Rank np-1 skips AllReduce so the collective is truly in-flight when revoke fires; over IB the device-side abortFlag must interrupt a network wait

tests.name: Revoke_NonBlocking_ThenShrink_NoRace
tests.description: Race commRevokeAsync worker thread against an immediate ncclCommShrink on the same parent across 10 iterations over IB transport; shrink must succeed

tests.name: Collective_Revoke_AsymmetricShrink_Collective
tests.description: Asymmetric shrink across nodes (unequal per-node GPU counts) forces ring-only topology after revoke; AllReduce must succeed on the child

tests.name: RepeatedRevokeShrinkCycles_ResourceCleanup
tests.description: Revoke parent then shrink then collective then revoke child then destroy across multiple generations; verifies no leaked resources

test_suites.name: Revoke MPI Tests (2-rank)
test_suites.description: ncclCommRevoke blocking and non-blocking coverage at 2 ranks on a single node: argument validation, lifecycle (revoke -> destroy/finalize/split), in-flight collective recovery, and async-job worker thread behavior

test_suites.name: Revoke MPI Tests (4-rank, single-node)
test_suites.description: ncclCommRevoke scenarios requiring 4 ranks on one node: truly in-flight collective recovery via shrink (device-side abortFlag path), NCCL_SHRINK_ABORT child rank renumbering, and non-blocking revoke/shrink race coverage

test_suites.name: Revoke MPI Tests - Multi-Node (4-rank, 2-node)
test_suites.description: ncclCommRevoke multi-node scenarios over IB transport: in-flight collective/P2P teardown, asymmetric shrink across nodes (ring-only topology after revoke), non-blocking revoke/shrink race, and repeated revoke/shrink generations to verify no leaked resources
